description: Whitespace fidelity of string tool arguments (vLLM issue 48753: the Qwen3 and Qwen3-Coder tool parser strips leading and trailing whitespace). Each probe asks the model to call an edit tool with an exact old_string; the whitespace report compares the argument as received with the expected string and names the first differing byte. Native tools only.
system: You are a coding agent working in a repository. When a task needs a tool, call the tool; do not describe the call in prose.

edit_file.name: edit_file
edit_file.description: Replace an exact string in a file. old_string must match the file byte for byte, whitespace included.
